pages.text: Build your own spells, glyph by glyph. Ars Nouveau is the Tier 2 magic mod: custom spell crafting, familiars and magical automation.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() At Tier 2, Ars Nouveau is where the Battlemage and the Archmage feel at home. Its glyph-based spell system lets you build custom spells around your class's strengths.$(br2)$(bold)Source generation:$() Ars Nouveau runs on Source. Source Jars and Sourcelinks are the core of your T2 mana automation.

$(bold)Faefolk synergy:$() The Nature Magic racial gives +10% spell power, and Ars Nouveau's nature-flavored spells gain the most from it.$(br2)$(bold)What unlocks at T2:$() Full spellbook access, the Bookwyrm familiar, the Drygmy for mob farming and the Whirlisprig for crop automation.

$(bold)Where the reference lives:$() In this pack the Codex replaces the mods' own guidebooks. Every glyph and apparatus recipe is in JEI; your first steps at T1 are in $(l:icraft:mods_t1/early_magic)Early Magic Tutorial$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Keys:$() $(k:ars_nouveau.open_book) opens your spell book's editor; $(k:ars_nouveau.previous_slot) and $(k:ars_nouveau.next_slot) switch spell slots.$(br2)$(bold)Next: inscribe your first spell at a Scribes Table.$()
